F1: website_name` is not in `untrusted_attributes` and has no working include gate, so the host/path is serialized for TL0 users viewed anonymously while `website` is hidden.
F2: AMS 0.8.3 only calls `include_<attr>?`, so `include_website_name` at `user_serializer.rb:153` is dead and `website_name` is always emitted (null when there is no website); the gem source is not in the repo, so the AMS behaviour is from knowledge of 0.8.x.
F3: preferences renders into the `user` template and binds `model.website`, but `save` never refreshes `website_name`, so the header label stays stale while the href updates.
